Register Mokel once

  1. Open GitHub’s OAuth app registration.
  2. Application name: Mokel R1. For this local setup, use http://localhost:4173/ as the homepage and http://localhost:4173/github-workspace.html as the callback URL.
  3. Register the app, enable Device Flow in its settings, and copy its public Client ID. Do not create or paste a client secret.

Authorize GitHub
